The patient is lying down, wearing a grey hairnet and metal eye shields. The doctor holds a white medical device with a glowing yellow tip against the patient's cheek. (2) The scene shifts to a medium shot of the doctor speaking directly to the camera while holding the device. She is in a well-lit indoor environment with wooden floors and a red velvet chair visible in the background. Another woman in a grey suit is seen in the background holding a phone. (3) Close-up shots show the device emitting bright flashes of light as it touches the patient's skin. The patient's face shows some redness. (4) The doctor uses her hand to point at the patient's facial contours, explaining the effects of the treatment. (5) The video ends with a white screen displaying the clinic's name 'DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC', social media handles, phone number, and addresses.
